name: Exterior Soffit RP Finish Coat 1
intent: RP finish coat 1. Cut-in at junctions (LF, qt_scaled) + field finish by method. 4 application methods. Coat 1 rates.
doctrine: RP soffit finish coat 1. Same rates as NC coat 1. Cut-in at 90 LF/hr (QT3 baseline, qt_scaled). Brush/roll 120, spray 250, spray_backroll 200, spray_backbrush 180. Open-face modifier (2.0x) applies. No intercoat sanding. Overhead rates baked in.
